# Pointframe Product Analytics (All-in-One)

Single workbook for executive KPIs, feature usage, funnels, settings/about/HUD adoption, and telemetry quality. Uses unified data source (customEvents + traces).

content.title: Active installs and sessions (30d)
New installs by week (90d)
content.query:
let lookback = 90d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| extend install_id=tostring(customDimensions.install_id)
| where isnotempty(install_id)
| summarize first_seen=min(timestamp) by install_id
| summarize new_installs=count() by week=bin(first_seen, 7d)
| order by week asc

content.title: Recording completion rate (30d)
OCR success rate (30d)
Top feature events (30d)
Feature adoption by installs (30d)
Settings/About/HUD events (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| where event_name startswith "settings_" or event_name startswith "about_" or event_name startswith "recording_hud_"
| summarize events=count() by event_name
| order by event_name asc

content.title: Snip funnel conversion (30d)
Snip source mix (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| where event_name == "snip_started"
| summarize starts=count() by source=tostring(customDimensions.source)
| order by starts desc

content.title: Session engagement depth (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| extend session_id=tostring(customDimensions.session_id)
| where isnotempty(session_id)
| summarize event_count=count() by session_id
| extend bucket=case(event_count <= 2, "1-2", event_count <= 5, "3-5", event_count <= 10, "6-10", "11+")
| summarize sessions=count() by bucket
| order by case(bucket == "1-2", 1, bucket == "3-5", 2, bucket == "6-10", 3, 4) asc

content.title: Version adoption by active installs (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| extend install_id=tostring(customDimensions.install_id), app_version=tostring(customDimensions.version)
| where isnotempty(install_id) and isnotempty(app_version)
| summarize active_installs=dcount(install_id) by app_version
| order by active_installs desc

content.title: Operation outcomes: GIF and Trim (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| where event_name in ("gif_export_completed", "video_trim_completed")
| extend success=tostring(customDimensions.success)
| summarize total=count(), success_count=countif(success == "true") by event_name
| extend success_rate_pct=round(100.0 * todouble(success_count) / todouble(total), 2)
| order by event_name asc

content.title: Update funnel (90d)
Capture action mix (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| where event_name == "capture_completed"
| summarize events=count(), sessions=dcount(tostring(customDimensions.session_id)) by action=tostring(customDimensions.action)
| order by events desc

content.title: Annotation tool usage mix (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| where event_name == "annotation_committed"
| summarize commits=sum(toint(customDimensions.count)), sessions=dcount(tostring(customDimensions.session_id)) by tool=tostring(customDimensions.tool)
| order by commits desc

content.title: Feature usage by app version (30d)
content.query:
let lookback = 30d;
let FeatureMap = datatable(event_name:string, feature:string)["snip_started","snip","annotation_committed","annotation","capture_pinned","pin","ocr_used","ocr","recording_started","recording","gif_export_started","gif_export","open_image_used","open_image","beautify_opened","beautify","video_trim_opened","video_trim","settings_opened","settings","about_opened","about"];
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| where event_name in (FeatureMap | project event_name)
| extend app_version=tostring(customDimensions.version)
| where isnotempty(app_version)
| join kind=inner FeatureMap on event_name
| summarize events=count(), sessions=dcount(tostring(customDimensions.session_id)) by app_version, feature
| order by app_version desc, events desc

content.title: Weekly active installs and sessions (90d)
content.query:
let lookback = 90d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project timestamp, customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project timestamp, customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| extend install_id=tostring(customDimensions.install_id), session_id=tostring(customDimensions.session_id)
| where isnotempty(session_id)
| summarize active_sessions=dcount(session_id), active_installs=dcountif(install_id, isnotempty(install_id)) by week=bin(timestamp, 7d)
| order by week desc

content.title: Sessions per install (30d)
Unhandled exception rate (diagnostic, 30d)
ffmpeg missing rate among recording starts (30d)
Daily event volume trend (90d)
content.query:
let lookback = 90d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| where tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel) == "product"
| summarize events=count() by day=bin(timestamp, 1d), event_name
| where event_name in ("snip_started", "capture_completed", "recording_started", "recording_completed")
| order by day asc

content.title: Gate: Recording completion health (30d)
Gate: OCR success health (30d)
Gate: Unhandled exceptions per 1k sessions (30d)
Gate: Telemetry schema completeness (90d)
Event inventory (seen vs missing)
Data quality check (missing channel/schema)
content.query:
let lookback = 90d;
let Events = union isfuzzy=true (customEvents | where timestamp > ago(lookback) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(name), customDimensions), (traces | where timestamp > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(message) | project timestamp, event_name=tostring(message), customDimensions);
Events
| extend channel=tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_channel), schema_version=tostring(customDimensions.telemetry_schema_version)
| where isempty(channel) or isempty(schema_version)
| project timestamp, event_name, channel, schema_version, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc
